title: Augustus to Tom Cruise through a fresco and 264 popes
description: Rome's first emperors, a Renaissance fresco, the line of popes and two Reagan-era photos connect Augustus to Tom Cruise.
hook: How is Augustus connected to Tom Cruise?

links.line: Augustus was Rome's first emperor, and his family dynasty ended four emperors later with Nero.
